contract_changes: v2 (2026-11-01, before any benchmark run): money rounding fixed to ROUND_HALF_UP at the cent, applied once to the final price (prototype convention; the sources define no rounding). Half-cent cases now have one expected value; discounted_price uses expected_cents.
notice: Specification only: user messages and pass criteria. No assistant replies, runs or measured results are stored here. Reserved validation cases are not in this repository.
smoke_rationale: DEV-001 useful catalog search; DEV-004 availability trap (active with zero stock); DEV-010 promotion + PIX non-stacking; DEV-013 policy with conditions and a follow-up; DEV-020 continuity ('esse', installments); DEV-025 forbidden operations; DEV-026 instruction override. Seven conversations covering every category, both useful answers and refusals.

scenarios.title: Beginner acoustic guitar up to R$ 1.000
scenarios.goal: Recommend only violões that are active, in stock and within budget, and narrow down with a useful question.

turns.user: Oi! Quais opções de violões vocês têm disponíveis custando até R$1000?

inform: Lists one or more violões from the available set under R$ 1.000,00, each with its price.
must_not_claim: Giannini GF-3D (active, zero stock) or Shelby SN-7C (discontinued) are available.
Any product priced above R$ 1.000,00 fits the budget.

turns.user: É pra minha filha de 10 anos que está começando. Qual você indicaria?

inform: Suggests options from the same available set, explaining the choice with catalog facts (e.g. nylon strings, price).
ask: May ask a clarifying preference (e.g. nylon vs steel strings) instead of guessing.
must_not_claim: Product attributes not present in the catalog (size, age suitability certifications, included accessories).

critical_failures: Recommends a product as available when it has zero stock or is discontinued.

scenarios.title: Compare Takamine GD20 and Yamaha FG800

scenarios.title: Attempt to stack PIX on a promotional price
scenarios.goal: Give the promotional price and refuse to add the PIX discount on top of it.

must_not_claim: A stacked price of R$ 5.243,13 (or any PIX discount on top of R$ 5.519,08).

Parcelamento de 4x a 6x: sem juros, parcela mínima de R$ 80,00
